tshark_cmds:
PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-11-26/2024-11-26-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

# Protocol hierarchy and conversation summary
echo "=== PROTOCOL HIERARCHY ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -q -z io,phs

echo ""
echo "=== TOP CONVERSATIONS BY BYTES ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -q -z conv,ip | head -20

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-11-26/2024-11-26-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== ARP: IP <-> MAC Binding ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "arp" -T fields -e arp.src.proto_ipv4 -e arp.src.hw_mac | sort -u

echo ""
echo "=== NetBIOS Names (NBNS) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "nbns" -T fields -e nbns.name -e ip.src | sort -u

echo ""
echo "=== DHCP Hostname and MAC ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "dhcp" -T fields -e dhcp.option.hostname -e dhcp.hw.mac_addr | sort -u

echo ""
echo "=== Kerberos Client Name (CNameString) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "kerberos.CNameString" -T fields -e kerberos.CNameString -e ip.src | sort -u

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-11-26/2024-11-26-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== HTTP Requests (Method, Host, URI) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "http.request" -T fields -e ip.src -e http.host -e http.request.method -e http.request.uri | head -30

echo ""
echo "=== TLS SNI (Server Name Indication) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "tls.handshake.extensions_server_name" -T fields -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e tcp.dstport -e tls.handshake.extensions_server_name | sort -u

echo ""
echo "=== DNS Queries from Victim ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "ip.src==10.11.26.183 && dns.qry.name" -T fields -e dns.qry.name | sort -u

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-11-26/2024-11-26-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== HTTP POST Requests from Victim (C2 Checkins) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "http.request.method==POST" -T fields -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e tcp.dstport -e http.host -e http.request.uri

echo ""
echo "=== NetSupport C2 Traffic Details (194.180.191.64) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "ip.src==10.11.26.183 && ip.dst==194.180.191.64" -T fields -e frame.number -e tcp.dstport -e http.request.method | sort -u

echo ""
echo "=== Exporting HTTP Objects ==="
mkdir -p /tmp/pcap-objs
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" --export-objects "http,/tmp/pcap-objs" -q 2>&1
ls -lah /tmp/pcap-objs/ | head -20

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-11-26/2024-11-26-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== All HTTP Requests with URI (unfiltered) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "http.request" -T fields -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e http.host -e http.request.method -e http.request.uri | grep -v "SSDP\|M-SEARCH" | sort -u | tail -30

echo ""
echo "=== TLS to IP (non-Microsoft) from Victim ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "ip.src==10.11.26.183 && tls.handshake.extensions_server_name" -T fields -e ip.dst -e tls.handshake.extensions_server_name | grep -v "microsoft\|bing\|google\|gstatic\|adobe\|office\|msn" | sort -u

echo ""
echo "=== Unique fakeurl.htm hashes (C2 Responses) ==="
cd /tmp/pcap-objs && find . -name "fakeurl*.htm" -type f -exec shasum -a 256 {} \; | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-11-26/2024-11-26-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== Largest TLS Conversations (potential malware downloads) ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "tls" -q -z conv,ip | head -15

echo ""
echo "=== Looking for modandcrackedapk.com traffic details ==="
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "ip.dst==193.42.38.139" -T fields -e frame.time -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e tls.handshake.extensions_server_name -e tcp.flags -e frame.len | head -20

echo ""
echo "=== All exported files with their sizes ==="
ls -lah /tmp/pcap-objs/ | grep -E "^\-" | awk '{print $5, $NF}' | sort -rn

echo "=== Content of index.php files ===" 
for f in /tmp/pcap-objs/index.php*; do
  echo "FILE: $(basename $f)"
  cat "$f" | head -c 500
  echo ""
  echo "SHA256: $(shasum -a 256 "$f" | awk '{print $1}')"
  echo ""
done

echo ""
echo "=== Content of foots.php ===" 
cat /tmp/pcap-objs/foots.php | hexdump -C | head -5

echo ""
echo "=== Tracing index.php requests in the PCAP ===" 
PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-11-26/2024-11-26-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "http && index.php" -T fields -e frame.time -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e http.host -e http.request.method -e http.request.uri

PCAP="/Users/yaakulyasabbani/Documents/GitHub/latex_researchpapers/Skill_Issue_LLM_PCAP_Forensics/datasets/evidence/mta-2024-11-26/2024-11-26-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap"

echo "=== HTTP requests containing 'index' ===" 
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "http.request.uri contains \"index\"" -T fields -e frame.time -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e http.host -e http.request.method -e http.request.uri

echo ""
echo "=== All conversation flows from suspicious IPs ===" 
/opt/homebrew/bin/tshark -r "$PCAP" -Y "ip.dst==193.42.38.139 || ip.dst==213.246.109.5 || ip.dst==79.124.78.197" -T fields -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e tcp.dstport -e tcp.flags -e frame.len | sort -u | head -20
